ranks.clock: Rank-local GPU event clock. No cross-rank timestamp alignment.
ranks.interval_semantics: Each event pair encloses one complete call on its caller stream. Outer calls contain graph intervals. Never add nested intervals.
ranks.waiting: Inter-call gaps are unattributed. They are not proved idle, removable, or recurrence-specific.
